implementation.capture: World authoring snapshots turn id, production id, exact bank template, language and interpolated variable values before appendSource. Registry boundaries and rendered text never supply authoritative variable values.
implementation.validation: validateTriviaRegistry requires independent trusted emission inputs, re-emits them and requires exact source bytes, segments/parts/boundaries, all optional positions and the complete canonical registry. validateFamily regenerates trusted inputs from its trusted lineage/member/seed instead of trusting the candidate tape.
implementation.authentication: Canonical per-family handles bind family/lineage/seed/namespace/source, registry, emission tape, rule bytes and template bank. Both manifest and freeze publish all 60 handles; freeze additionally hashes the table and pilot manifest and independently re-generates all actual authoring inputs before pinning them.
implementation.consumer: verifyFamilyTrivia({family,registry}, trustedHandle) checks the externally pinned handle, replays authenticated inputs and returns a deeply frozen detached registry copy. Never obtain the trusted handle from the candidate submission.
implementation.interface: README.md authentication repair section; exported API in trivia.mjs

limits: No scorer, harness or protocol files edited; no sibling suites run.
Scorer P1-1 integration must adopt the v2 registry and call the exported authenticated verifier before compiling licenses.
A digest is not a secret signature. The expected freeze/manifest must be trusted and externally pinned; self-declared candidate hashes cannot establish trust.
The repair still requires non-author re-review and downstream recertification; it authorizes no paid execution.
